notes.title: Mutant Alley goes VR!
notes.content:
[b]Mutant Alley - VR Support DLC now available![/b]

Mutant Alley can now be experienced in virtual reality. The new VR support DLC fully supports SteamVR and can be purchased now!

Supported Headsets:

[list]
[*] HTC Vive
[*] Valve Index
[*] Oculus Rift / S
[*] Oculus Quest 1/2 (Via Link)
[/list]
